beats.text: *notices Shadow sat alone*
Hey, Rouge! You sitting with us?
Huh? *notices Rouge in the classroom*
Thanks for the offer, but I'm gonna go sit with Shad-
Damn girl, you are one lucky chick to have a boyfriend like him
What do you mean?
*putting make up on* Well, he's the coolest, and one of the hottest but most importantly he's the team captain for the SEGA team
I love Shadow for who he is, not because he's cool, hot or the team captain
Sure then, so would you rather have him being ugly, weird and a loser?
This isn't any of your business, so I hope you don't mind but I'm gonna go sit with him *walks away from them*
Oh, Rouge... of course we all don't mind
Hey Shadow! *walking towards him*
Oh I bet you're here just to show me off to your girlfriends
and why would I do that?
because you're- because-
Nevermind, you can sit *pulls out seat next to him*
Why thank you. You're such a gentleman *grabs her seat*
*chuckles*
Eh, what's so funny?
Nothing, it's just a little awkward that you're sitting right next to me
I can get up and sit somewhere else if you want
No, no.. it's fine.. I just thought you'd sit with the girls
With them? Nah, I just wanna spend some time with you before we graduate
That's cool
So...
So...
I'll be cheering for you in the game
Oh so you're a cheerleader now?
Um haven't you seen me? I was in some of your practices
All I've seen is you singing and flirting with the idiots at the same time
Why - you jealous?
No
Alright, remind me not to kiss you next time
That's not what I meant
Oh.. *blush*
( Seeing Rouge blush... that's something new )
Why are you looking at me like that?
( Look away! ) *looks at work* No reason
Sorry to interrupt, but may we speak with Shadow please?
( This better be good )
If it's about your gameshow then of course
SONIC
It's not a gameshow
Hey, Shad! Wait! *writing something on a piece of paper*

beats.card: Note: Sorry about yesterday, love you <3 x

beats.text: Hurry up, we haven't got all day
Shut up, moron *passes note back to Rouge* *walks out the classroom*
